mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the next month signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-month window, or 20-day returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDPC1 (GDP) above 17,000 signals robust demand growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive when GDPC1 crosses above 17000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in PAYEMS (employment) and decline in UNRATE (unemployment) indicates labor market tightening, reducing risk premium and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above previous 3-month high AND UNRATE crosses below previous 3-month high
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies move in expected directions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of GDPC1 crossing above 17,000 and HOUST rising above previous highs signals peak demand in a late-cycle expansion, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above 17000 AND HOUST crosses above previous high
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies move in expected directions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in INDPRO (supply index) above 105, coupled with accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS below 1.5%), signals improved supply conditions and positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO crosses above 105 AND FEDFUNDS crosses below 1.5%
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies move in expected directions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime, UNRATE falling below 3.0% signals reduced labor market friction, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive in low-unemployment regimes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in INDPRO above 105 signals improved supply conditions, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive when INDPRO crosses above 105 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a soft landing expectation regime, sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 1.5% signals accommodative policy, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive in soft landing regimes (t-test p > 0.05).
